fixtureSemantics.expectedMatching: Expected objects are partial constraints unless a case explicitly says exact.
fixtureSemantics.absence: A missing JSON key represents wire-level omission. Strings such as missing or omitted appear only as declarative operation metadata, never as wire values.
fixtureSemantics.dispatch: Consumers select cases by area and id; Core implementation tasks add repository-native runners.
fixtureSemantics.copyPolicy: Files with the same contractVersion must remain byte-identical across consuming repositories.

dashboard: diagnostic rendering through the separate diagnostics corpus
monitoring-core-nodejs: diagnostics corpus only; Node does not evaluate assertions

included: scalar, type, header, status-code, raw-body, and existence assertions
v1/v2 compatibility and canonical assertion change detection

checkFields.comparison: one of: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, greater_than, less_than, is_null, is_not_null, is_string, is_number, is_boolean, is_array, is_object, exists, not_exists
checkFields.target: required only for target-based comparisons; omission and explicit null remain distinguishable

sourceMatrix.targetRule: Scalar target for target-based comparisons; structured targets are invalid in Core.
Range targets are numbers; equality also accepts a legacy numeric string.

supported: single-predicate filter using @.<path> and ==, !=, <, <=, >, or >= against a string, number, boolean, or null literal

numericPolicy.scalarCoercion: Preserve v1 boolean and numeric-string equality for Core scalar comparisons.
numericPolicy.decimalComparison: Compare supported JSON numbers by exact decimal value rather than binary float approximation.

multiMatchPolicy: All selected values must satisfy the comparison. Use a filter plus exists for an at-least-one condition.

headerPolicy.repeatedValues: join received values in order with a literal comma and no added whitespace
headerPolicy.exists: true when at least one field value is present

noMatchPolicy.v2: No selected node is distinct from selected JSON null; only not_exists passes for no match.

explicitNullTargetPolicy: For no-target comparisons, explicit target null remains valid for compatibility but is canonically distinct from omission. New UI payloads omit target. Null is invalid for target-based equality.
invalidConfigurationPolicy: Evaluate before AND/OR aggregation; a passing OR branch cannot hide invalid configuration.

operationalOutcomeTransport.schedulerBehavior: Record bounded operational telemetry, do not call state processing, do not increment down counters, do not publish to the processor, and schedule the next regular check at normal cadence.
operationalOutcomeTransport.customerBehavior: Preserve monitor and incident state and send no customer alert.
operationalOutcomeTransport.assertionDiagnostics: Omitted for notEvaluated outcomes; these are operational results, not incident snapshots.
